reason: In authz/client/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/client/util/crypto/ASN1Decoder.java:71-73, `readInteger()` passes a length of 0 straight to `read(0)` and then `new BigInteger(new byte[0])`, which throws the unchecked NumberFormatException ("Zero length BigInteger") rather than the method's declared IOException. The only in-repo caller of the conversion, core/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/ECDSASignatureSignerContext.java:33-35, catches `Exception` and feeds it DER produced by the local JCA signer, so the bad input is not realistically reachable there.
